# Tanks — 2D Top-Down Shooter

## Project Overview

**Tanks** is a 2D top-down shooter developed in Unity and published on [Yandex Games](https://yandex.ru/games/). The project focuses on modular C# architecture, maintainable gameplay systems, and browser-based deployment.

## Key Features

* **Modular Architecture:** Reusable components and loosely coupled gameplay systems designed to support future extensions.
* **Object Pooling:** Reuses projectiles to reduce runtime allocations and garbage collection overhead.
* **Yandex Games Integration:** Platform SDK integration for game publishing.
* **WebGL Deployment:** Build configuration and performance considerations for browser-based gameplay.
